title: Protocol and Safehouse
author: Edmund Lockridge
blurb: Ada Zhou, a fixer for an embassy that doesn't officially exist, keeps a go-bag packed and a lie polished. But when a voiceprint unlocks a server on another continent, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must extract a defector who may be the bait, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
